purpose: Stable acceptance criteria for the three neutral source categories required by THEF-16. Expectations are source-independent: derived only from the Swift/ObjC source semantics, not from any migrated app. Each AC has a real total denominator (business or guard), a source anchor, and an honest verification status. Business (normal/normal-cancel/exception) ACs run on the REAL candidate target via the host oracles and enter the business denominator; guard (mutation/missing-evidence) ACs prove the oracle discriminates a real defect and are listed separately. Build/device/source-execution are UNVERIFIED by environment, not by choice.

swiftui_binding_navigation.summary: SwiftUI @State identity + two-way @Binding across NavigationStack (SwitchRow toggle, Detail Disable button). Covers binding identity, the shared backing store, and cross-navigation write-back.

acs.expectation: enabled starts false; one Toggle flip -> true; second flip -> false (single shared binding source).
Detail 'Disable' writes false back to the shared binding (cross-navigation write-back). Host-logic verified; actual ArkUI navigation write-back UNVERIFIED (no device).
Toggle is a real flip, not a constant; repeated toggle alternates. Guard: oracle must reject a toggle-constant mutant AND prove the mutation applied.
disable() must write false; guard: oracle must reject a disable-no-op mutant AND prove the mutation applied (a candidate already broken there cannot claim GUARD-OK).

uikit_objc_event_resource.summary: UIKit/ObjC viewDidLoad init + IBAction add: wired to button touchUpInside + countLabel outlet (event wiring + resource).

acs.expectation: load -> count 0 / 'Count: 0'; each tap -> +1 and label 'Count: N'. Host-logic verified; actual device tap/render UNVERIFIED (no device).
Business increment is exactly +1; +2 mutant must be rejected. Guard: prove the mutation applied.
countLabel outlet wiring preserved; silent label loss must be detected. Guard: prove the mutation applied and detection is real.

async_cancel_persist_exception.summary: ObservableObject save Task with cancellation, UserDefaults persistence, and typed error branches.

acs.expectation: add then save (no cancel) -> 'Saved' and savedCount persisted. Host-logic verified; actual device async UNVERIFIED.
save then cancel before write -> 'Cancelled', nothing persisted.
cancellation must protect persistence; disabled cancel mutant rejected. Guard: prove the mutation applied.
persistence target not silently dropped; missing prefs.set detected. Guard: prove the mutation applied and detection is real.

honest_limits.build: UNVERIFIED: this run has no HarmonyOS HAP build (no DevEco assemble invoked; contract forbids building user app). Real ArkTS compile/UI/device stay unverified.
honest_limits.device: UNVERIFIED: hdc list targets = [Empty]; no iOS execution, no ArkUI device click, no visual alignment.
honest_limits.source_execution: UNVERIFIED: Windows host has no Xcode; Swift/ObjC not compiled or run.
honest_limits.note: Host oracles execute the actual authored target .ets logic via DevEco TypeScript transpile + Node vm. They verify business semantics and discriminate mutants; they do NOT claim ArkUI rendering or device pass. The neutral evidence is consumed by the shipped behavior.verify gate (neutral_consume.py), which executes the real cases and decides PASS/FAIL.
